evaluations.evidence: view a list of sponsors
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: presenting a list of sponsors; attributes are not independent features.

evaluations.evidence: view a list of user profiles

evaluations.evidence: email all the trainers at once from the website
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: bulk-email trainers; not combining a separate independent feature.

evaluations.rationale: Single feature: providing a map showing buildings/rooms (attributes of one feature).

evaluations.rationale: Appears to be one feature: trainers editing their training node (including slide links as content), not two independent features.

evaluations.rationale: Single constraint/feature on registration; not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: admin view that helps track registration status for each attendee
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: an admin view showing registration statuses (statuses are attributes).

evaluations.evidence: be added to a training waitlist

evaluations.rationale: Single feature: acceptance of terms via checkbox.

evaluations.rationale: Single feature: integrate a cancellation deadline into the workflow; not multiple independent features.

evaluations.evidence: add to "my schedule"
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: adding an item to user's schedule (conditional on schedule existing doesn't make it multiple features).

evaluations.evidence: see which trainings I have signed up for
evaluations.rationale: Single feature: view user's enrolled trainings.

evaluations.evidence: have a view ... that shows all attendee information

evaluations.rationale: Single feature: admin trainee information view with filtering (filtering is an attribute of the view).
